{{Current events|year=2018|month=07|day=15|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2015–2018 Iraqi protests]]
**Demonstrations in [[Muthanna Governorate|Muthanna Province]], [[Iraq]], leave 16 protesters killed or injured and 33 others arrested. [https://www.iraqinews.com/features/16-protesters-killed-injured-33-others-arrested-in-demonstrations-at-iraqs-muthanna/ (Iraqi News)]

;Business and economy
*Flights from [[Iran]] to [[Najaf]], [[Iraq]], are diverted to [[Baghdad]] due to anti-government protests. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crises-iraq-iran/iran-flights-to-iraqs-najaf-redirected-to-baghdad-iranian-state-tv-idUSKBN1K50F0 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*An earthquake of 6.2 magnitude strikes off [[Yemen]], but there are no reports of any damage or casualties. [https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2018/07/14/world/middleeast/14reuters-yemen-quake.html (''The New York Times'')]
*MV ''Shunqiang 2'' collides with another ship off [[Shanghai]], causing thirteen to fall overboard and the ship to sink. [[Search and rescue]] operations commence for the missing seafarers. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-07/16/c_137328850.htm (Xinhua)]
*A fire in a copper mine in [[Limpopo]], [[South Africa]] kills five and traps a sixth. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/07/15/africa/south-african-copper-mine-deaths/index.html (CNN)]

;International relations 
*[[Iran and weapons of mass destruction]], [[Iran–Israel proxy conflict]]
**New details from [[Iran]]ian nuclear documents stolen by [[Israel]]i spies show that [[Tehran]] obtained weapons-design information from a foreign source and was on the cusp of mastering key bombmaking technologies when the research was ordered halted [[Timeline of the nuclear program of Iran|15 years ago]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/papers-stolen-in-a-daring-israeli-raid-on-tehran-archive-reveal-the-extent-of-irans-past-weapons-research/2018/07/15/0f7911c8-877c-11e8-8553-a3ce89036c78_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Haiti]]
**[[Haiti]]an [[Prime Minister of Haiti|Prime Minister]] [[Jack Guy Lafontant]] resigns after deadly protests against fuel price rises. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-44836472 (BBC)]

;Science and technology 
*[[2018 lower Puna eruption]]
**A tiny island of [[lava]] forms north of the [[Kapoho, Hawaii|Kapoho]] ocean entry on [[Hawaii (island)|Hawaii island]]. [http://www.staradvertiser.com/2018/07/14/breaking-news/theres-a-tiny-new-island-of-lava-off-hawaii-island/ (''Star Advertiser'')]

;Sports
*[[Manny Pacquiao vs. Lucas Matthysse]]
**In [[boxing]], [[Manny Pacquiao]] [[Knockout|knocks out]] [[Lucas Matthysse]] in the seventh round to win the [[WBA Welterweight Champion|WBA welterweight championship]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-boxing-welterweight-pacquiao-matthyss/revived-pacquiao-stuns-matthysse-to-claim-welterweight-crown-idUSKBN1K5038 (Reuters)]
*[[2018 FIFA World Cup Final]]
**In [[Soccer|football]], France defeats Croatia 4–2 to claim its second [[FIFA World Cup|World Cup]] championship. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/44754965 (BBC Sport)]
**Celebrations across France see two killed, 45 injured, and 292 arrested. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/2-die-in-france-during-world-cup-celebrations/1205883 (A.A.)]
*[[2018 Wimbledon Championships]]
**In men's professional [[tennis]], [[Novak Djokovic]] defeats [[Kevin Anderson (tennis)|Kevin Anderson]] in three sets to win his fourth [[The Championships, Wimbledon|Wimbledon]] championship. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/tennis/44839313 (BBC Sport)]
